items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think I heard him on some of the Eddie Condon broadcasts, but I never saw him in person.

ctx.x: Did you get a chance to hear Sidney Bechet perform?
Not in person, no. Never. I think I heard him on some of the Eddie Condon broadcasts, but I never saw him in person.
Yeah, cause he was an ex-pat, in Paris for many, many years.
